data.narrative:
PILGRIM is a seed-stage defense and security company founded by Jake Adler that has raised $4.3M to date. The valuation assessment draws from a peer universe of ten comparable companies—two public (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and eight private entities including UFORCE, Anduril Industries, Helsing, Shield AI, and Saronic—spanning seed through Series A stages within the Defense & Security sector.

Two valuation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis uses the $4.3M raised as a baseline proxy and applies a 2.5x multiplier typical for seed-to-next-stage advancement, yielding an implied value of $11M. Peer-median analysis references five directly comparable companies (UFORCE at $1.0B seed stage, Castelion at $1.0B Series A, Stark Defence at $4.0B Series A, Singularity at $400M Series A, and NODA AI at $125M Series A), producing a median valuation of $1.0B with a range spanning $125M to $4.0B.

The triangulated analysis across both methods supports a valuation range of $9M (low) to $1.1B (high), with a median of $505M. The wide dispersion reflects material uncertainty around stage advancement pace, competitive positioning within a heterogeneous peer set, and the substantial valuation variance observed across similar-stage defense-tech companies. The peer-median approach carries particular weight given direct comparability, though early-stage companies in this sector exhibit wide variance based on technology differentiation and customer traction.
